purpose: Teach: 小川/右側/パーツ/コンパクト/ストア/キャッシュ/漁業/五輪

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、本気で、絶対、お祖父ちゃんちの、絶対、小川、絶対、ぼく、絶対、覚えてるよ
lines.en: Mom, I really do remember the little stream by Grandpa's house. I really do.
lines.style: Quiet, insistent. Small voice trying to prove something to himself as much as to her. Slight breathiness on the repeated affirmations. Not loud—just determined.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、本気で、絶対、お家の、絶対、右側、絶対、お部屋、絶対、お片付けね
lines.en: Sho, that's wonderful. But first, let's really focus on tidying up the right side of your room, okay?
lines.style: Warm redirect. Not dismissive of what he said—acknowledging it while pivoting gently to the task at hand. Practical but not unkind. Mother's light hand on the rudder.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、本気で、絶対、ぼくの、絶対、自転車の、絶対、パーツ、絶対、お父さんと、絶対、変えたよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad and I really did change out the parts on my bike. We really did the whole thing ourselves.
lines.style: Proud and eager to be heard. Sits up straighter in the voice. Wants her to understand the importance of what he and Dad did together. Small but genuine shine in the delivery.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、本気で、絶対、コンパクト、絶対、な、絶対、お弁当箱、絶対、ママ、絶対、買ったわよ
lines.en: That's great, Sho. And by the way, I picked up that compact lunchbox you wanted—the one we talked about.
lines.style: Practical warmth. A small gift offered matter-of-factly, as if it were always part of the plan. Not making a big show of it—just slipping it in where it belongs. Composed, attentive.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、本気で、絶対、ぼく、絶対、駅前の、絶対、ストア、絶対、行きたいよ
lines.en: Mom, I really want to go to the store by the station. Can we go? I really want to.
lines.style: Hopeful and slightly insistent. Energy picks up—he's been patient, now he's asking. Not whiny, but eager. The particular urgency of a child who wants something small and specific.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: お買い物、本気で、絶対、キャッシュ、絶対、で、絶対、払いましょうね、翔くん
lines.en: When we go shopping, we'll pay with cash like we always do. Shall we, Sho?
lines.style: Calm agreement wrapped in routine. She's already decided yes—the style says we'll do this together, the way we do things. No drama, just the clear logistics of a mother who includes her son in the practical world.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、本気で、絶対、地理で、絶対、漁業、絶対、習ったよ
lines.en: Mom, we learned about fishing industries in geography today. Did you know that?
lines.style: Animated and proud of his new knowledge. Sitting forward slightly, wanting to share something he's just discovered. The energy of a child bringing home something from school that feels important. Bright.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 家族で、本気で、絶対、五輪、絶対、テレビで、絶対、観戦しましょう、翔くん
lines.en: That's wonderful, sweetheart. You know, the whole family should watch the Olympics together on TV soon. What do you think?
lines.style: Tender, inviting, almost dreamy. She's weaving his world into a larger family moment. Soft opening, genuine interest in his response. The voice of a mother imagining a good evening ahead.
